lines.zh: 紫色的身子一伸一缩地爬。
lines.en: My purple body stretches and contracts as I crawl.
I follow the vein toward the tip.
Every little stretch, two bites.
The leaf is slick. I hold tight.
My segments ripple over the leaf.
I start from the stem end.

lines.zh: 爬过的地方留下一道淡痕。
lines.en: A faint trail follows my crawl.

lines.zh: 我绕开一片枯黄的地方。
lines.en: I avoid a yellowed patch.
Dew clings to my purple fuzz.

lines.zh: 我慢慢越过叶子的折痕。
lines.en: I cross the leaf's crease slowly.
I inch toward the light.
A short way takes me a long while.

lines.zh: 虫洞边缘太薄，我不敢踩。
lines.en: The hole's rim is thin. I will not step there.
I move onto another leaf.
My weight bows the leaf.
I stop and lift my head.
I lie on the leaf without moving.

lines.zh: 紫色的影子落在叶脉上。
lines.en: My purple shadow falls on the vein.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里的碎叶。
lines.en: I slowly chew the leaf in my mouth.
I bend my body into an arc.
Dew drips from the leaf tip.
Dew beads on my purple fuzz.
I arch my back to dry my fuzz.
My fuzz stands up slightly.
The leaf sways, and I sway.
I listen to water in the jungle.
This part of the leaf is thick.
I am in no hurry to grow.
Your face is too near the leaf.
Purple. Hard to spot, is it not?
I am right here on this vein.
Please do not shake this tree.

lines.zh: 你手里的瓶子，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the bottle in your hand.
I keep to this leaf.
You stepped in water. It is slippery.
I can stay perfectly still.
You stare at me, and the leaf stays still.
Purple is harder to find in leaf shade.
My whole body curled up.
A tuft of purple fuzz came off.
I tremble against the leaf.
The pain is in my third segment.
I slowly straighten.
A little green stains the leaf.

lines.zh: 我死死抱住最粗的叶脉。
lines.en: I cling hard to the thickest vein.

lines.zh: 紫色的皮破了一点，不碍事。
lines.en: A bit of my purple skin split. No matter.
I stay still until you go.
Do not touch me twice.
Is that one freshly grown?
This old one is too tough.
Move me over there.
I will eat nothing but leaves.
I smell leaf sap.
Do not wave it in front of me.
This one's edge is curled.
Hand me one more leaf.
I can bite through this.
Without a leaf, I am finished.
You pressed down on me.
I slipped across the leaf.
Gently. I will fall.
Your nudge rocks the leaf.
I am underneath. Do not reach in.
My purple body slides under the leaf.
I shift half an inch along the vein.
You stepped on the stem.
I move to the other side.
Slow down a little more.

lines.zh: 我在这个阶段不长翅膀。
lines.en: At this stage I have no wings.
Speak of it when I leave the chrysalis.
There are plenty of my kind here.
I must eat my fill first.
Too early for a caterpillar.
The leaf is shaking. Stop talking.
I still have a molt to go.
We can talk of it later.

lines.zh: 紫色毛虫还不会想这些。
lines.en: A purple caterpillar doesn't think of that yet.
Let me eat in peace.
I bite a small piece of vein.
Only fallen leaves down there.

lines.zh: 我抓不住这么重的东西。
lines.en: I cannot hold anything this heavy.
I drag this leaf along.
I hold it with my thoracic legs.
It slid off the leaf.
I pick up a fragment.
This will last me a while.
I shove it aside and go back to the leaf edge.
Put it back. That is not mine.
The leaf has begun to shake.
I see a shadow.
I press onto the vein.
I slip into the leaf's crease.
Purple is not obvious. Maybe I can hide.
I dare not move any further.
Something is under the leaf.
I look up and freeze.
I should not have climbed so high.
Let the wind come faster.
I will stay perfectly still.
The leaf edge is right beside me.
I have drawn my head in.
Your breath stirs the leaf.
My purple shadow shrinks into the fold.
I am wedged in the crease.
The leaf is wet and hard to cross.
I shrink by degrees.
Any closer and I drop.
It is enough that you keep still.
I bite the edge and pull.
I butt my head in.

lines.zh: 我这一口，连皮都咬不破。
lines.en: My bite can't even break skin.
I only snapped a stem.
My body gave a small spring.
I flick with my rear.
I bumped the vein.
I let out a little silk.
That much force reaches nothing.
I shrink back and keep eating.

lines.zh: 我在这一片叶的折缝里。
lines.en: I am in this leaf's fold.
My purple body is beaded with dew.
Leaves everywhere in this jungle.
I slowly come around from the underside.
I bit through my first leaf.
There are kin nearby.
Thick leaves. Plenty to eat.
First, let me find the light.
My fuzz is not dry yet.
Two steps, and I stop.

lines.zh: 热浪把我的紫色烤暗了。
lines.en: The heat has darkened my purple.
I slid partway off the leaf.
Water wraps me and I cannot move.
The blast flips the leaf over.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎穿叶子，差一点。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the leaf, close by.
This light makes my fuzz shine.
The leaf is stripped. I go hungry.

lines.zh: 一道白光，整棵树都亮了。
lines.en: A white flash lights the whole tree.
The leaf is gone. I am falling.
